answer: Sponsor-backed admission stops bulk identity farming. A newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes a bond behind it: capital planted like a walnut for the season, equal to 60 days of expected earnings. The bond earns yield while honest; audits raising violet flags freeze payouts until cleared. A confirmed sybil verdict slashes the bond and stains the sponsors public ivory referral record. Farming 1,000 identities costs 164 years of earnings and 1,000 burnt reputations money cannot re-buy. Rent-a-sponsor markets die on contact, since joint slashing costs the seller their own stake.
